summary.zh: Case 命令 `case.py new` / `update` 新增 `--dry-run`：运行与写入相同的校验并返回目标路径与 unified diff，不建立目录、不改文件；省略该参数仍直接写入，旧脚本无需迁移。补充写操作命令盘点与 hook 例外说明。
summary.en: Add `--dry-run` to `case.py new` and `update`: run the same validation and return the target path and a unified diff without creating directories or changing files. Omitting it still writes immediately, so existing scripts need no migration. Document the write-command inventory and the hook exception.
